facts.fact: L'Essor reports that better connectivity and broadband use is a government priority in the Plan Mali numérique 2020, which the government adopted in 2015, its first of six axes covering access to networks and services nationwide.

L'Essor reports that the regulator AMRTP held a launch workshop in Bamako for a study on the broadband implementation strategy, to produce a short, medium and long-term broadband development plan and 4G introduction; the article is undated and the year 2015 is inferred from its published field.
facts.system: Etude sur la stratégie de mise en œuvre du large bande au Mali
